## What's new

- **Glass like Apple Music.** Kultr follows your iPhone's light or dark setting now (you can still pick one in Settings → Appearance), so on iOS 26 the tab bar and mini player are the same clear liquid glass as in Apple Music, with your music showing through.
- **On iOS 17 and 18** Kultr's own bar looks much more like it too: a clear, rounded slab of glass with a lit edge. The tab you are on sits in a quiet glass pill, and when you touch the bar a clear lens, bigger than the bar, follows your finger and magnifies the tabs under it.
- **Readable colours in light mode.** When the colour taken from the artwork is too pale for a light background, it is deepened just enough to read.

## Install

Download **Kultr.ipa** below and install it with **Sideloadly** (Windows, Mac), **AltStore** (Windows, Mac) or **Impactor** (Linux). New to this? Follow the step-by-step guide: https://github.com/evropiani/Kultr_iOS/blob/main/docs/INSTALL.md

Installing over an earlier version keeps your servers, library, listening history, analysis and downloads — install it with the same Apple ID and don't delete the old app first.
